pages: Nell Farrow, a girl of eleven, dark hair in a short bob, a dark green duffel coat with its hood down and a red knitted scarf, stands in a dark field with one silver stopwatch open in her palm, looking north. Middle distance: a wire fence, a hedge. Background: a sky washed pale at the edges, a low ridge.

Nell Farrow, a girl of eleven, dark hair in a short bob, a dark green duffel coat with its hood down and a red knitted scarf, stands at the field gate with one hand flat on the lid of a plain wooden box. Middle distance: a stopwatch in her other hand. Background: the dark field below, a clean northern sky.

Nell Farrow, a girl of eleven, dark hair in a short bob, a dark green duffel coat with its hood down and a red knitted scarf, sits on the grass with one silver stopwatch in her fist, the crown under her thumb, face tipped up. Middle distance: a fence post. Background: a few stars beginning to show in the dark.

Nell Farrow, a girl of eleven, dark hair in a short bob, a dark green duffel coat with its hood down and a red knitted scarf, stands holding one silver stopwatch, her other hand raised flat to shield her eyes from a hard white beam sweeping the grass. Middle distance: the fence. Background: the sky gone flat and grey.

Nell Farrow, a girl of eleven, dark hair in a short bob, a dark green duffel coat with its hood down and a red knitted scarf, holds one silver stopwatch up in front of her, her head lowered, her eyes turned away from the sky, blinking hard. Middle distance: a fence post. Background: a blank grey sky over the hedge.

Nell Farrow, a girl of eleven, dark hair in a short bob, a dark green duffel coat with its hood down and a red knitted scarf, crouches pressing the crown of one silver stopwatch with her thumb, her hand unsteady. Middle distance: a fence post, the wet grass. Background: the field, a sky just beginning to give a few stars.

Nell Farrow, a girl of eleven, dark hair in a short bob, a dark green duffel coat with its hood down and a red knitted scarf, stands in grass with one silver stopwatch lowered at her side, chin up. Middle distance: the hedge, a fence post. Background: the pale band of the Milky Way rising over the hedge, stars crowding.

Nell Farrow, a girl of eleven, dark hair in a short bob, a dark green duffel coat with its hood down and a red knitted scarf, tilts her head back, one silver stopwatch forgotten in her hand, her gaze just to the side of a small knot of stars. Middle distance: the fence line. Background: a dense field of stars.

Nell Farrow, a girl of eleven, dark hair in a short bob, a dark green duffel coat with its hood down and a red knitted scarf, sits on the grass with one silver stopwatch laid face-up beside her, head turned a little aside, eyes half-lidded. Middle distance: the hedge, a fence post. Background: a small knot of stars.

Nell Farrow, a girl of eleven, dark hair in a short bob, a dark green duffel coat with its hood down and a red knitted scarf, stands at the field gate in first grey light, holding out one plain wooden box holding a folded sheet of paper. Middle distance: the open gate. Background: the bare hedge, a paling sky.

Nell Farrow, a girl of eleven, dark hair in a short bob, a dark green duffel coat with its hood down and a red knitted scarf, stands at the hedge in grey before dawn, one silver stopwatch open in her palm, face turned up to a pale wash of light. Middle distance: the gate. Background: the lane, a paling morning.
